items.title: Why Corning (GLW) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of glass and electronic component manufacturer Corning (NYSE:GLW) fell 2.7% in the afternoon session after reports that key customer Apple scrapped its planned all-glass 20th-anniversary iPhone model, raising concerns about future demand for the company's specialty glass.
